sources.label: E1 NYPSC petition 20-E-0083
sources.note: The filed petition directly establishes the reviewed APPH hierarchy, transaction sellers, project interests and proposed consortium allocations, while disclosing that ownership weights could be adjusted at closing. It is historical regulatory evidence, not a final or cutoff-current member ledger.

sources.label: E2 NYPSC May 19, 2020 order
sources.note: The direct commission document preserves the 2020 transaction, member, pension-beneficiary and project-level boundaries. It does not supply a September 2026 cap table or prove later ownership continuity.

sources.label: E3 Munich Re H1 2020
sources.note: Munich Re's direct half-year report identifies 2020-06-18 as the MR Gotham completion date. It does not establish the complete current APPH ownership schedule.

sources.label: E4 Munich Re FY2025
sources.note: Munich Re's direct 2025 annual report reports MR Gotham LP at 20.0000% of Astoria Power Partners Holding as of 2025-12-31. That one disclosed interest does not establish every other member or the complete cutoff-current cap table.

sources.label: E5 CalSTRS holdings
sources.note: CalSTRS' direct holdings page includes Golden Inferno in its June 2025 disclosure but does not disclose a Gotham percentage, final 2020 adjustment, APPH look-through or cutoff-current transfer history.

sources.label: E6 ENGIE closing release
sources.note: ENGIE's direct closing release states that APPH acquired 100% of APP I and approximately 55% of APP II and names the seller groups and consortium members. It also distinguishes the merchant APP I plant and NYPA-contracted APP II plant from their owners.

sources.label: E7 NYPSC 25-E-0762
sources.note: The direct 2026 commission document concerns debt authorization and operating arrangements. It does not confirm current equity members, final consortium allocations or an ownership transaction.

sources.label: E8 S&P October 30, 2025
sources.note: The rendered direct S&P article reports that Astoria Energy LLC refinanced approximately $650 million with a seven-year $900 million term loan. That financing fact does not prove equity continuity or a current ownership allocation.

exactException: No direct source provides the executed final Gotham closing schedule or funds-flow true-up, a cutoff-dated APPH or Gotham member ledger, later transfer and assignment records, or audited look-through schedules that establish every APG, CalSTRS, Clal, Harbert, GPP/CalPERS and other institutional interest as of 2026-09-04. The evidence also does not prove that Astoria Energy Partners LLC or Astoria Project Partners Holdings LLC is a reciprocal legal alias of APPH.
conclusion: DEFERRED. Preserve APPH as the probable one-platform survivor candidate and the verified 2020 transaction and Munich Re facts as research lineage, but do not merge, create or update owners, vehicles, stakes or status until final closing allocations and cutoff-current ownership are directly evidenced.
